items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: It was a group of young fellows that had gotten together in Bud Johnson. That's a tenor player. You might know him. Bud Johnson was one of the original members.

ctx.x: well you don't have anything. That's right. May I ask a question here? Do you know anything about Leroy's Dallas band Leroy who? Leroy's Dallas band. They recorded on Columbia, Bill.

I think that was a part of the Blue Moon Chasers. Now I'm not sure. Well, who were the Blue Moon Chasers? It was a group of young fellows that had gotten together in Bud Johnson. That's a tenor player. You might know him. Bud Johnson was one of the original members.
He's still playing in the management. That's right. Well, that was the Blue Moon Chasers.
